sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano I: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Soprano II: a figure from countersubject 2 and the opening of countersubject 1, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted. Tenor: the opening of countersubject 1, inverted (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 2, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to C minor; perfect cadence in B♭ major at bar 47

sections.label: Episode 2

Soprano II: a figure from countersubject 2 (7 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 2, inverted and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 2 (9 times) and a figure from countersubject 2, inverted, in a sequence rising by a fourth every two bars. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: Between two statements in C minor; perfect cadence in C minor at bar 59
